bullets.text: first frost on the car windshield. scraped it with a library card. the library would not approve.
🌙 overcast at okunoin, nine degrees. the duck carries a line about smiles and bread. a stone lantern wears a moss cap.
feeding a sourdough starter that has outlived two houseplants and one phone.
soft. like the middle of a loaf, not the crust.
